name: ArMee Infotech Limited
summary: ArMee Infotech Ltd. provides IT infrastructure solutions and managed IT services, supplying hardware and software and installing and integrating them to client specifications. It reports in two segments: IT Infrastructure Solution and Managed Services, and Renewable Energy. Ridhish Kiritbhai Patel founded it in 2003, and it is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.
